answer: Require each identity to lock 130 POA for 44 epochs and complete ten unpredictable jobs per round, with a 9-of-16 established jury signing replayable receipts. One missed round freezes rewards; two slash 70% of the juniper bond. Funding-linked entrants cross a meadow where each new bond doubles, making clone costs geometric. The ledger verifies task hashes, quorum signatures, timestamps, and funding ancestry; a mirror-output detector links aliases to the higher tier.
